description: Handle two special keyword cases before the main classifier. otto retry: creates a new task referencing the original source comment, to be run fresh with the same context. otto cancel, otto stop, otto disregard, and similar reserved phrases: respond with a status comment explaining that cancellation is not supported in this version, then mark the task ignored. Neither triggers a run or worktree.
title: otto retry and reserved keyword handling (cancel, stop → clarify)
